svg.title: Three-player Xiangqi label outlines
svg.desc: Unaltered FandolKai Regular 0.3 outlines, centered by ink bounds, with longest ink dimension 1. Fandol team (Clerk Ma and Jie Su), GPL with font exception. Source: https://ctan.org/tex-archive/fonts/fandol. Used as document lettering, not a runtime font. See three-player-xiangqi-font.LICENSE.txt.
